_written: 2026-10-10, before computing any pair-trading return. Track C gen21.
pair_choice: economic relatedness only (same asset class/region/commodity complex), fixed before any spread statistic was computed; no correlation screening
data: Dukascopy D1 closes (same 00:00 UTC stamp for both legs); *_inv = 1/price
model: beta_t = OLS slope of log A on log B over the trailing 252 days ending at t (formation strictly before trading); spread_t = logA - beta_t logB; z_t = (spread_t - mean_60) / std_60 using data through t
trading: enter short spread at z > 2, long at z < -2; exit at |z| < 0.5, after 20 days, or stop at |z| > 4; decisions at close t, position held from close t+1
sizing: 1 unit of leg A notional and beta units of leg B per position, scaled by 1 / trailing-60d spread return vol (risk parity across pairs)
costs: per unit turnover of each leg: qpl.instruments.SPOT_COST_PRICE_UNITS / price; stress 2x

gates.DEV: pooled net Sharpe >= 0.5 AND >= 4/6 pairs positive AND >= 2/3 neighbours positive
gates.TEST: single look: net Sharpe > 0 at 1x and >= 0 at 2x

known_prior: v1 H8 (NQ/ES relative strength) and v3 V6 lead-lag were rejected on intraday data
